subject: Webhook endpoint returns 500 after payment_intent.succeeded event
body: Our webhook handler started throwing 500 errors for payment_intent.succeeded events. The signature verification passes but our database update fails. Events are being retried every hour. How do we handle this without losing events?

subject: Stripe-Signature header verification always fails in production
body: We set up webhook signature verification using Stripe's Python library. In local development it works fine, but in production we always get SignatureVerificationError. We're using Flask and the endpoint_secret is correct.

subject: Not receiving webhook events for failed payments
body: We subscribed to payment_intent.payment_failed events but we're not receiving them. We receive payment_intent.succeeded fine. Our endpoint URL is correct and shows as active in the Dashboard.

subject: Webhook events arriving out of order causing data inconsistencies
body: We're processing invoice.created and invoice.paid events but sometimes invoice.paid arrives before invoice.created. This causes our order system to fail.

subject: Duplicate webhook events being processed multiple times
body: We're seeing the same webhook events processed 2-3 times. Our handler returns 200 but Stripe keeps resending. Average handler time is 8 seconds.

subject: Webhook endpoint not receiving events after DNS migration
body: After migrating our DNS, webhook endpoint stopped receiving events. Stripe Dashboard shows events as failed with TLS error.

subject: How to replay missed webhook events from last 24 hours
body: We had some issues with our webhooks last week and I think we may have missed some events. Can you help us figure out what we need to do?

subject: Webhook events for Connect accounts not being received
body: We have a Connect platform and want to receive webhook events from connected accounts but only receive events from our own account.

subject: Payment failing with card_declined error but test card should succeed
body: I'm using the test card 4242424242424242 with a future expiry but getting card_declined errors. My API key is the test secret key.

subject: Payments failing with insufficient_funds for valid live cards
body: Multiple customers reporting their cards are declined with insufficient_funds even though they have available credit. This started after we updated our integration.

subject: 3D Secure authentication loop — customers cannot complete payment
body: Customers in Europe are stuck in a 3D Secure authentication loop. Affects roughly 30% of EU customers.

subject: PaymentIntent stuck in requires_action state
body: Several PaymentIntents are stuck in requires_action status for days. These are bank redirect payments. How long before these automatically expire?

subject: do_not_honor decline code on all new card payments
body: A lot of our payments have been failing lately. It wasn't happening before. Something seems off but I'm not sure where to start.

subject: Currency mismatch error when creating PaymentIntent
body: Getting an error: The currency requested does not match the currency of the customer. We're trying to charge a customer in GBP.

subject: Payment capture failing after 7-day hold
body: We use manual capture for hotel bookings. A customer checked in today but capture is failing. The authorization was created 8 days ago.

subject: Authentication error: No such API key
body: Our integration suddenly stopped working with 'No such API key' error. The key is loaded from an environment variable. Live mode was working yesterday.

subject: 403 Forbidden when using restricted API key
body: I created a restricted API key with read permissions on charges. When I try to list charges I get 403 Forbidden.

subject: API key works locally but fails in production Docker container
body: Our Stripe API key works locally but fails in production Docker with authentication errors. The key is set as an environment variable.

subject: How to rotate API keys without downtime
body: We need to rotate our production API keys due to a suspected security incident. We process thousands of payments per day and cannot have downtime.

subject: Live mode keys not working despite switching from test mode
body: I switched from test to live mode but still getting authentication errors in my backend. I updated my publishable key but forgot the secret key.

subject: Refund request failing — charge already disputed
body: We're trying to refund a customer but getting: The charge you are attempting to refund has a pending dispute. Can we still refund?

subject: Lost dispute — what evidence should we have submitted?
body: We lost a chargeback dispute for a $450 software subscription. Reason code was 'services not provided'. What evidence is most effective for digital goods?

subject: Partial refund showing as full refund in customer's bank
body: A customer is saying their refund amount doesn't look right. I'm not sure exactly what happened on our end or how to check.

subject: Dispute deadline in 2 days — how to submit evidence quickly
body: We just noticed a dispute expiring in 2 days. We have order confirmation, delivery tracking, and email correspondence. Can we submit evidence via API?

subject: Refund processing time longer than expected
body: One of our customers is asking about their refund. They say they haven't received it yet. What should I tell them?

subject: How to add a second team member with limited access
body: I want to add a support team member who can view disputes and issue refunds but cannot access API keys or change account settings.

subject: Account temporarily restricted — unable to process payments
body: Our Stripe account shows it is restricted and payments are paused. We submitted verification documents 3 days ago but the restriction is still in place.

subject: Custom statement descriptor not appearing on customer statements
body: We configured a custom statement descriptor in the Dashboard but customers still see our legal business name. We also tried setting it on individual PaymentIntents.

subject: Payout schedule changed unexpectedly to manual
body: Something seems wrong with how money is moving in our account. It doesn't look the same as it used to. Can you check?

subject: How to enable Apple Pay and Google Pay on Checkout
body: We want to enable Apple Pay and Google Pay for our Stripe Checkout integration. They don't appear in the checkout form despite enabling them in the Dashboard.

subject: How do I integrate Stripe with my WordPress blog?
body: Hi, I run a personal blog on WordPress and want to accept donations. Is there a Stripe plugin for WordPress? Also do you have any recommendations for themes that work well with payment forms? Thanks
